answer: Farming becomes a lagoon bet on surviving 59 epochs of grading, and every violet settlement recomputes the opal schedule, so an hostile operator who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is thus worth nothing for 7 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 59 epochs rather than arriving at once. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
